winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

briefs.speaker: Daniel Munwaring
briefs.current_title: IMAX中国CEO：暑期档高端格式票房增16%，观众更挑剔
current_title_lines: 观众更挑剔，愿意为好内容买单

subtitles.zh: 是的，我认为今年暑期档的关键词是‘高端化’。
subtitles.en: Yeah. I think the story of the summer here is really premium.

subtitles.zh: 观众对想看的内容和观影格式越来越挑剔。
subtitles.en: I mean, audiences are becoming more and more particular and picky about what they want to watch and the formats for which they want to watch it.

subtitles.zh: 一个有趣的数据是，高端格式票房同比增长16%，而普通影厅基本持平。
subtitles.en: One interesting stat is premium formats are up 16% year over year, whereas regular auditoriums are pretty much flat.

subtitles.zh: 我们占据了其中的大部分。暑期市场份额增长至接近6%，约5.9%，总票房达1.1亿美元。
subtitles.en: Obviously, we would make up a big majority of that. Our market share over the summer grew all to just under 6%, about 5.9%, totaling $110 million.

subtitles.zh: 而这仅靠中国不到1%的银幕数量实现。
subtitles.en: And that's all on less than 1% of the total screens in China.

subtitles.zh: 观众非常明确自己的需求，一旦决定，就愿意为之付费。
subtitles.en: So audiences are being very particular about what they want, they're deciding what they want, and then they're willing to go and spend the money for what they want.

briefs.speaker: Daniel Munwaring
briefs.current_title: IMAX中国CEO：口碑驱动一切，本土与好莱坞佳作齐飞
current_title_lines: 本土与好莱坞佳作齐飞

subtitles.zh: 我认为口碑是第一驱动力。
subtitles.en: You know, I think that number one word of mouth is driving everything, right?

subtitles.zh: 所以不再区分好莱坞还是本土，观众只想要真正的好电影。
subtitles.en: So it's no longer is it Hollywood or is it local? Audiences just want a really good movie.

subtitles.zh: 以《蜘蛛侠》开画周末为例，我们创下该系列历史新高，票房超过1900万美元，占大盘16%以上。
subtitles.en: Looking at Spider-Man opening weekend, we open to a franchise historical high of over $19 million doing 16 plus percent of the box office.

subtitles.zh: 《奥德赛》也是今夏的现象级作品，我们贡献了该片总票房的55%，累计约4900万美元。
subtitles.en: And you know, Odyssey, again, another phenomena this summer, you know, we were doing 55% of the total box office on that title. I think we're up to 49 million overall.

subtitles.zh: 我们看到了本土与好莱坞影片的健康组合，但核心还是品质，观众对品质的要求越来越高。
subtitles.en: So I think we're seeing a healthy mix of local language as well as Hollywood titles. But it's really about quality, audiences are demanding quality.

briefs.speaker: Daniel Munwaring
briefs.current_title: IMAX中国CEO：影院成旅游目的地，国庆档及后续大片蓄势
current_title_lines: 国庆档及后续大片蓄势

subtitles.zh: 是的，你之前提到观众回归影院，这点很关键。
subtitles.en: Sure. So, you know, to your earlier point, I think you made a good one, which is just this return to the cinemas.

subtitles.zh: 我们在中国的GT影厅已成为旅游打卡地。
subtitles.en: You know, we've got these theaters in China called GT Auditoriums and they've become destinations for tourism.

subtitles.zh: 事实上，近50%的GT影厅观众来自外地。
subtitles.en: In fact, almost 50% of the audiences who are attending these GT systems are coming from out of town.

subtitles.zh: 我们从未见过如此大规模的人群，乘飞机或火车数百英里，专程来体验我们的巨型GT系统。
subtitles.en: That's something that we've really never seen before where you have huge groups of people flying and taking trains hundreds of miles to go visit this very particular giant GT system that we have.

subtitles.zh: 话题都围绕电影。我认为这股势头会持续，通常暑期档大片会带动观众重回影院。
subtitles.en: So, conversation is all around films. I think this momentum is going to continue, you know, typically when you have these big hits over the summer, they bring back that behavior of going back to the cinema.

subtitles.zh: 观众开始期待未来新片。接下来有国庆档‘十一’假期。
subtitles.en: People start to look ahead at what's coming out. Obviously looking into the future, we've got, you know, the National Holiday, which is coming up during Shiyi, the October 1st, looking ahead of that.

subtitles.zh: 《毁灭战士3》计划12月在中国上映，《复仇者联盟：末日》也是在中国表现极佳的大IP。
subtitles.en: We have Doom 3, which is scheduled to release hopefully here in China in December, Avengers Doomsday, another massive franchise that has done extremely well in China.

briefs.speaker: Daniel Munwaring
briefs.current_title: IMAX中国CEO：AI助力电影制作，降本增效带来更好故事
current_title_lines: 降本增效带来更好故事

subtitles.zh: 中国对AI的拥抱程度令人惊叹。
subtitles.en: Well, I think one interesting thing about China is, you know, the embracement of AI is tremendous here.

subtitles.zh: IMAX已在流媒体技术和端到端解决方案中广泛应用AI。
subtitles.en: You know, we are, we're seeing it with iMacs, obviously, we've been using AI in a lot of our streaming technology and some of our end-to-end solutions in that area.

subtitles.zh: 后期制作也是如此。我们本质是电影人公司，相信AI将极大惠及创作者。
subtitles.en: Post-production is well well, but, you know, we're a filmmaker first company. So we think AI is going to be hugely beneficial for filmmakers.

subtitles.zh: AI是创作者的又一工具，无论是前期分镜、剧本场景搭建，还是后期制作。
subtitles.en: It's another tool for them to use, whether it's in the storyboarding process, you know, early on as they set up the script and set up scenes or more particularly in post-production.

subtitles.zh: AI将持续降低成本，成为讲好故事的得力工具。
subtitles.en: I think it's going to continue to bring down costs and be a productive tool for better storytelling.

subtitles.zh: 因此会有更多资金涌入，也会诞生更好的电影。我们对此非常乐观。
subtitles.en: And as a result, you're going to see more capital blow into it and you're also going to see better movies. So we're extremely optimistic about it.

events.candidate_system_prompt:
You are a Chinese viral-title angle architect. Return strict JSON only. Do not write a safe summary. Generate competing, fact-grounded emotional angles for each clip. Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.
- Prefer neutral market-language alternatives: 流动性变化、信贷变化、债务压力、政策信号、需求变化、信心修复、估值重估、周期压力、结构调整、市场波动、边际变化.
- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.
- Title fields must not use financial-advice or product-sale wording such as 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出. Rephrase with neutral market wording such as 资管、配置、权益资产、市场、产品、财富配置、保障、观点.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.

- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

briefs.current_title: IMAX中国CEO：暑期档高端格式票房增16%，观众更挑剔
current_title_lines: 观众更挑剔，愿意为好内容买单

subtitles.zh: 是的，我认为今年暑期档的关键词是‘高端化’。
subtitles.en: Yeah. I think the story of the summer here is really premium.

subtitles.zh: 观众对想看的内容和观影格式越来越挑剔。
subtitles.en: I mean, audiences are becoming more and more particular and picky about what they want to watch and the formats for which they want to watch it.

subtitles.zh: 一个有趣的数据是，高端格式票房同比增长16%，而普通影厅基本持平。
subtitles.en: One interesting stat is premium formats are up 16% year over year, whereas regular auditoriums are pretty much flat.

subtitles.zh: 我们占据了其中的大部分。暑期市场份额增长至接近6%，约5.9%，总票房达1.1亿美元。
subtitles.en: Obviously, we would make up a big majority of that. Our market share over the summer grew all to just under 6%, about 5.9%, totaling $110 million.

subtitles.zh: 而这仅靠中国不到1%的银幕数量实现。
subtitles.en: And that's all on less than 1% of the total screens in China.

subtitles.zh: 观众非常明确自己的需求，一旦决定，就愿意为之付费。
subtitles.en: So audiences are being very particular about what they want, they're deciding what they want, and then they're willing to go and spend the money for what they want.

current_title_lines: 本土与好莱坞佳作齐飞

subtitles.zh: 我认为口碑是第一驱动力。
subtitles.en: You know, I think that number one word of mouth is driving everything, right?

subtitles.zh: 所以不再区分好莱坞还是本土，观众只想要真正的好电影。
subtitles.en: So it's no longer is it Hollywood or is it local? Audiences just want a really good movie.

subtitles.zh: 以《蜘蛛侠》开画周末为例，我们创下该系列历史新高，票房超过1900万美元，占大盘16%以上。
subtitles.en: Looking at Spider-Man opening weekend, we open to a franchise historical high of over $19 million doing 16 plus percent of the box office.

subtitles.zh: 《奥德赛》也是今夏的现象级作品，我们贡献了该片总票房的55%，累计约4900万美元。
subtitles.en: And you know, Odyssey, again, another phenomena this summer, you know, we were doing 55% of the total box office on that title. I think we're up to 49 million overall.

subtitles.zh: 我们看到了本土与好莱坞影片的健康组合，但核心还是品质，观众对品质的要求越来越高。
subtitles.en: So I think we're seeing a healthy mix of local language as well as Hollywood titles. But it's really about quality, audiences are demanding quality.

briefs.current_title: IMAX中国CEO：影院成旅游目的地，国庆档及后续大片蓄势
current_title_lines: 国庆档及后续大片蓄势

subtitles.zh: 是的，你之前提到观众回归影院，这点很关键。
subtitles.en: Sure. So, you know, to your earlier point, I think you made a good one, which is just this return to the cinemas.

subtitles.zh: 我们在中国的GT影厅已成为旅游打卡地。
subtitles.en: You know, we've got these theaters in China called GT Auditoriums and they've become destinations for tourism.

subtitles.zh: 事实上，近50%的GT影厅观众来自外地。
subtitles.en: In fact, almost 50% of the audiences who are attending these GT systems are coming from out of town.

subtitles.zh: 我们从未见过如此大规模的人群，乘飞机或火车数百英里，专程来体验我们的巨型GT系统。
subtitles.en: That's something that we've really never seen before where you have huge groups of people flying and taking trains hundreds of miles to go visit this very particular giant GT system that we have.

subtitles.zh: 话题都围绕电影。我认为这股势头会持续，通常暑期档大片会带动观众重回影院。
subtitles.en: So, conversation is all around films. I think this momentum is going to continue, you know, typically when you have these big hits over the summer, they bring back that behavior of going back to the cinema.

subtitles.zh: 观众开始期待未来新片。接下来有国庆档‘十一’假期。
subtitles.en: People start to look ahead at what's coming out. Obviously looking into the future, we've got, you know, the National Holiday, which is coming up during Shiyi, the October 1st, looking ahead of that.

subtitles.zh: 《毁灭战士3》计划12月在中国上映，《复仇者联盟：末日》也是在中国表现极佳的大IP。
subtitles.en: We have Doom 3, which is scheduled to release hopefully here in China in December, Avengers Doomsday, another massive franchise that has done extremely well in China.

briefs.speaker: Daniel Munwaring
briefs.current_title: IMAX中国CEO：AI助力电影制作，降本增效带来更好故事
current_title_lines: 降本增效带来更好故事

subtitles.zh: 中国对AI的拥抱程度令人惊叹。
subtitles.en: Well, I think one interesting thing about China is, you know, the embracement of AI is tremendous here.

subtitles.zh: IMAX已在流媒体技术和端到端解决方案中广泛应用AI。
subtitles.en: You know, we are, we're seeing it with iMacs, obviously, we've been using AI in a lot of our streaming technology and some of our end-to-end solutions in that area.

subtitles.zh: 后期制作也是如此。我们本质是电影人公司，相信AI将极大惠及创作者。
subtitles.en: Post-production is well well, but, you know, we're a filmmaker first company. So we think AI is going to be hugely beneficial for filmmakers.

subtitles.zh: AI是创作者的又一工具，无论是前期分镜、剧本场景搭建，还是后期制作。
subtitles.en: It's another tool for them to use, whether it's in the storyboarding process, you know, early on as they set up the script and set up scenes or more particularly in post-production.

subtitles.zh: AI将持续降低成本，成为讲好故事的得力工具。
subtitles.en: I think it's going to continue to bring down costs and be a productive tool for better storytelling.

subtitles.zh: 因此会有更多资金涌入，也会诞生更好的电影。我们对此非常乐观。
subtitles.en: And as a result, you're going to see more capital blow into it and you're also going to see better movies. So we're extremely optimistic about it.

subtitles.en: And I think we kind of have a long way to go. Especially now, when we're seeing globally, the trend is original movies, you know, an original, unique, fresh content.

subtitles.zh: AI很难做到这一点，因为它本质上是在已有内容上训练。

briefs.speaker: Mark Renfield
briefs.current_title: 美债策略师：市场与美联储不同步，财政部或出奇招
current_title_lines: 财政部或出奇招稳定市场

subtitles.zh: 当市场与政策层不同步时，投资者能看穿，这通常不是好兆头
subtitles.en: Investors can see through that when they're not on the same page, typically that's bad

subtitles.zh: 对市场而言，这已反映在美国债券上。
subtitles.en: for a market, and that's being reflected in US bonds.

subtitles.zh: 美国财政部会怎么做？人们开始认为，他们可能不只是购买长期债券，
subtitles.en: What could the US Treasury do? People are now really starting to think that rather than just buying long-term bonds,

subtitles.zh: 甚至可能抛出更极端、出人意料的措施，市场完全没有预料到，目的是压低价格、稳定市场。
subtitles.en: they may even throw something far more extreme and out of left field at the market, which is completely not expecting to try and bring prices down to try and stabilize the market.

subtitles.zh: 这类措施有时会有短期效果，但长期看往往损害较大，而市场正在为此做准备。
subtitles.en: Sometimes those kinds of things have a short-term effect. In the long run, they're normally quite damaging, but that's what people are bracing for.

subtitles.zh: 市场正防备财政部采取完全出乎意料的行动，前所未有，但可能给市场带来短期缓解。
subtitles.en: They're bracing for the US Treasury to do something, which is not in the game plan at all. Something never tried before, but it may bring some short-term relief to the market.

current_title_lines: 长端利率走高，债市领跌
权益市场承压，如何应对？

subtitles.zh: 欢迎回来，您正在收看《中国节目》，今天开盘在即。
subtitles.en: Welcome back. You're watching the China show going into the open today.

subtitles.zh: 这是一个重要的跨资产宏观主题：收益率和长端债券领跌，日本20年期国债收益率持续上行。
subtitles.en: It's really a big cross-asset macro story with the yield space and the bond lead on the long end continuing to give the 20-year in Japan.

subtitles.zh: 继昨日10年期收益率之后，20年期收益率触及1996年以来最高水平。
subtitles.en: Just hit the highest since 1996 following its 10-year cousin yesterday.

subtitles.zh: 新西兰联储即将公布利率决议，而能源市场的表现已足以说明当前这种循环和压力周期。
subtitles.en: We have a rate decision coming here out of the RBNZ and a glance at the energy market tells you everything you need to know about this loop, this doom cycle we're in.

subtitles.zh: 是的。
subtitles.en: Yeah.

subtitles.zh: 正如我所说，考虑到通胀压力，可能会连续加息。
subtitles.en: As I said for a back-to-back rate hike as well, just given those inflationary pressures as well.

subtitles.zh: 因此，今天债市的抛售似乎不会暂停，宏观因素主导了当前的市场波动。
subtitles.en: So that doesn't seem like there's going to be any sort of a pause in this bond sell-off in any ways here today and you take a look at the macro picture, that seems to be dominating the moves that we're seeing.
